description.text:
Nemotron-Content-Safety-Reasoning-4B is a Large Language Model (LLM) classifier designed to function as a dynamic and adaptable guardrail for content safety and dialogue moderation (topic-following).

Its primary advantage is the ability to enforce custom safety policies. Users can "bring their own safety policy", and the model will adapt its classification and reasoning to meet those specific, user-defined criteria.

output_type.quote: Nemotron-Content-Safety-Reasoning-4B is a Large Language Model (LLM) classifier designed to function as a dynamic and adaptable guardrail for content safety and dialogue moderation (topic-following).

warning.quote: The model may misclassify or fail to detect harmful content for categories not well-represented in its training data (e.g., specific types of harassment, threats, or hate speech).

serving.notes: The card says max token length 128K. config.json text_config max_position_embeddings is 131072. tokenizer model_max_length is a placeholder (1e30), not a context limit. The card's generate() example sets do_sample=False and max_new_tokens=400. The vLLM example sets temperature 0.0 and max_tokens 400. The classifier instructions are the user message. tokenizer_config use_default_system_prompt is false. chat_template.jinja can emit an image token, and config.json has a vision_config; every example on the card is text. trainer_state.json for this checkpoint: global_step 3900, epoch 2.1739130434782608, train_batch_size 2, num_train_epochs 5, max_steps 8970. The logged learning rate peaks at 9.999998485637598e-07 at step 900. The file latest contains global_step3900. No adapter_config.json. The repo includes zero_to_fp32.py and eight rng_state files. The weight index total is 4300079472. The linked EMNLP paper trains Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct and Gemma-3-4B on WildGuardMix. It does not name this repository.
